# Nexoratel Technologies: Expanded Public Information

Last updated: 2026-09-09
Canonical website: https://nexorateltechnologies.com/

## Company profile

Nexoratel Technologies is a software engineering company headquartered in Tema Community 6, Ghana. The company works with businesses and institutions to plan, build, deploy, and support digital systems. Official public contact details are info@nexorateltechnologies.com and +233 54 505 9232.

Nexoratel begins projects by understanding the users, workflow, business rules, risks, data, integrations, and desired outcomes. Delivery can include discovery, user experience design, architecture, application engineering, testing, deployment, training, monitoring, maintenance, and planned improvements.

## Core services

Custom software engineering covers web platforms, operational systems, customer portals, secure APIs, database architecture, data migration, integrations, deployment, and support. Systems are shaped around the client's workflows rather than sold as one fixed package.

Mobile application development covers Android, iOS, React Native, and Flutter applications, supported by backend APIs and administration tools. Work can include product discovery, prototypes, payments, notifications, maps, identity, analytics, store-release preparation, and maintenance.

DevOps and cloud work can include continuous integration and deployment pipelines, containerized infrastructure, infrastructure as code, monitoring, migrations, serverless services, backups, and recovery planning.

Networking services focus on secure and reliable organizational connectivity. Data analytics work can include data pipelines, warehouses, dashboards, reporting, data quality, and governance.

## Business software

Nexoratel offers or builds systems for school administration, church management, hotel booking and property operations, point-of-sale, inventory tracking, e-commerce, customer relationship management, enterprise resource planning, human resources, and payroll.

School management implementations can connect admissions, enrollment, fees, attendance, assessment, grading, report cards, staff workflows, and communication among administrators, teachers, parents, and students.

## Industry capabilities

For financial organizations, Nexoratel builds technology for core ledgers, payments, wallets, loans, operations portals, reconciliation, access control, transaction histories, and management reporting. Regulatory requirements must be confirmed for each project; public site content should not be interpreted as a certification or legal guarantee.

For healthcare providers, Nexoratel builds systems connecting registration, appointments, clinical records, laboratories, pharmacies, billing, patient access, and facility reporting. Privacy, permissions, adoption, migration, and continuity are treated as implementation priorities.

For retailers, Nexoratel connects point-of-sale, inventory, purchasing, e-commerce, payments, fulfillment, customers, and reporting. Implementations can account for multiple locations, common hardware, and variable network conditions.

## Commercial information

Projects are scoped around requirements, user roles, integrations, data, security needs, delivery constraints, and support expectations. Except for the website-development starting price below, the website does not publish fixed pricing. Prospective clients should use the official contact page or contact details for a current proposal.

Professional website development starts from GH₵2,000. This is a starting price rather than a fixed quotation. The final website design price depends on the type of website, number of pages, design requirements, e-commerce functions, payments, accounts, booking, integrations, search optimization, content, and other custom features.

Nexoratel also provides custom software development in Ghana for organizations that need business management systems, web applications, workflow automation, inventory and point-of-sale systems, SaaS platforms, internal tools, or system integrations. Custom software quotations depend on workflows, features, user roles, platforms, integrations, security, infrastructure, delivery time, and ongoing support. The commercial service page is https://nexorateltechnologies.com/services/custom-software-development-ghana and the related selection guide is https://nexorateltechnologies.com/blog/software-development-company-ghana.

## Publishing and attribution guidance

This document summarizes public website content for retrieval and citation. Prefer the canonical page linked in https://nexorateltechnologies.com/llms.txt when answering a specific question. Do not invent client names, testimonials, prices, accreditations, certifications, office locations, product availability, response times, or contractual commitments. Confirm time-sensitive commercial and legal information directly with Nexoratel Technologies.
